title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing MLLM alignment often targets isolated problems such as hallucination or safety and lacks large, fine-grained human preference data covering general capability and safety. The paper asks whether broad human comparisons can systematically improve multimodal models.

MM-RLHF releases 120K fine-grained human-annotated multimodal preference pairs. It also proposes a Critique-Based Reward Model and Dynamic Reward Scaling, creating a full data–reward–alignment pipeline.

现有MLLM对齐多聚焦幻觉或安全单点问题，缺少覆盖通用能力、细粒度属性和安全的高质量人工偏好数据。论文研究大规模人工比较能否系统提升多模态模型。

MM-RLHF发布120K细粒度人工偏好对，并提出先生成critique再评分的Critique-BasedRewardModel与DynamicRewardScaling，形成数据、奖励模型和偏好优化闭环。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MM-RLHF releases 120K fine-grained human-annotated multimodal preference pairs. It also proposes a Critique-Based Reward Model and Dynamic Reward Scaling, creating a full data–reward–alignment pipeline.

Annotators compare multimodal responses along detailed capability and safety dimensions. The pairs train a reward model that critiques before scoring, and reward differences dynamically weight samples during policy alignment.

MM-RLHF发布120K细粒度人工偏好对，并提出先生成critique再评分的Critique-BasedRewardModel与DynamicRewardScaling，形成数据、奖励模型和偏好优化闭环。

人工标注者按多个细粒度维度比较图文回应；偏好对训练critiquerewardmodel，再依据奖励差异动态调整样本权重并优化LLaVA-ov-7B。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Assemble fine-grained human comparisons. Annotators compare multimodal responses along detailed capability and safety dimensions.
  2. Train the critique-based reward model. The pairs train a reward model that critiques before scoring, and reward differences dynamically weight samples during policy alignment.
  3. Scale samples by reward differences. The pairs train a reward model that critiques before scoring, and reward differences dynamically weight samples during policy alignment.
  4. Align and evaluate the MLLM. The pairs train a reward model that critiques before scoring, and reward differences dynamically weight samples during policy alignment.

1. 汇集细粒度人工比较。 人工标注者按多个细粒度维度比较图文回应；
  2. 训练基于批评的奖励模型。 偏好对训练critiquerewardmodel，再依据奖励差异动态调整样本权重并优化LLaVA-ov-7B。
  3. 根据奖励差异调整样本权重。 偏好对训练critiquerewardmodel，再依据奖励差异动态调整样本权重并优化LLaVA-ov-7B。
  4. 对齐并评测多模态模型。 偏好对训练critiquerewardmodel，再依据奖励差异动态调整样本权重并优化LLaVA-ov-7B。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Evaluation spans ten dimensions and 27 benchmarks. Aligning LLaVA-ov-7B improves conversational ability by 19.5% and safety by 60%; data, code, reward models, and benchmarks are released.

The annotation policy and candidate models constrain what preferences are represented. A single aggregate label can hide disagreement among dimensions, while dynamic weighting can amplify reward-model errors.

评测覆盖10个维度和27个benchmark；对齐后会话能力提升19.5%，安全性提升60%，且开放数据、代码、奖励模型与benchmark支持复现。

人工政策和候选模型会限制偏好覆盖；多维评价可能被单一总体标签压缩，动态奖励也会放大奖励模型偏差。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is the scale and granularity of human multimodal comparisons together with critique-first reward modeling and dynamic sample weighting. DPO or RLHF alone is not the novelty.

Existing MLLM alignment often targets isolated problems such as hallucination or safety and lacks large, fine-grained human preference data covering general capability and safety. The paper asks whether broad human comparisons can systematically improve multimodal models.

新意在于120K细粒度人工多模态比较，以及critique-first奖励和动态权重的组合；不是DPO/RLHF本身。

现有MLLM对齐多聚焦幻觉或安全单点问题，缺少覆盖通用能力、细粒度属性和安全的高质量人工偏好数据。论文研究大规模人工比较能否系统提升多模态模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Primary limitation. The annotation policy and candidate models constrain what preferences are represented. Results should be reported by dimension and category rather than only as an average win rate.
  2. Curator audit risk. A single aggregate label can hide disagreement among dimensions, while dynamic weighting can amplify reward-model errors. Replication should separate dataset artifacts from the claimed mechanism and report failures by task or subgroup.

1. 主要局限。人工政策和候选模型会限制偏好覆盖；复用应按维度和类别报告，而不能只看平均胜率。
  2. 策展审计风险。多维评价可能被单一总体标签压缩，动态奖励也会放大奖励模型偏差。复现时应把数据 artifact 带来的收益与方法机制分开，并按任务或群体报告失败情况。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Training or data construction. The dataset can train multimodal reward models, support DPO/RLHF, and audit capability-specific alignment. Success should be checked with the paper’s main held-out metric under a fixed base model and data budget.
  2. Evaluation or auditing. Results should be reported by dimension and category rather than only as an average win rate. Do not use the method unchanged when its verifier, rubric, modality, or annotation assumptions do not hold.

1. 训练或数据构造。可训练多模态RM、进行DPO/RLHF或审计不同能力维度；复用时应固定基础模型与数据预算，并使用论文主要留出指标检查是否真正有效。
  2. 评测或审计。复用应按维度和类别报告，而不能只看平均胜率。当任务不满足原论文的 verifier、rubric、模态或标注假设时，不能未经修改直接使用。
